name: B10-0150/2025 (S&D) – White paper on the future of European defence
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a major overhaul of how Europe defends itself. It wants a clear defence strategy, much more military and financial support for Ukraine, and joint buying of weapons instead of each country acting alone. It asks for far more money for defence, including common EU borrowing, and for Europe to be able to act without relying on the United States. This is a set of demands and opinions; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament demands a defence strategy, joint weapons buying and much more defence money.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, the defence industry, Ukraine, and EU taxpayers who would fund it.
- **What happens next:** The Commission presents its defence white paper on 19 March 2025; the EU and member states must then decide.
